gizmo.title: Chochitika cha nkhani
gizmo.description: Chochitika chimodzi cha nkhani yanthambi. Lumikizani chisankho chilichonse ku chochitika china ndi # yotsatiridwa ndi ID ya chochitikacho.

configure.title: ID ya chochitika
configure.description: Zomwe zisankho zimalumikizana nazo: ulalo wopita ku # wotsatiridwa ndi ID iyi umatsogolera ku chochitika ichi. Zilembo, manambala ndi makansalu.

configure.title: Mathero
configure.description: Ngati chochitika ichi chimathetsa njira, ndi momwe zinathera.

configure.title: Zigoli
configure.description: Zigoli zofika ku mathero awa. Zigoli zapamwamba kwambiri za mathero mu nkhaniyo ndizo zochuluka kwambiri.
